benefit_text: The scheme offers loan categories. Shishu covers loans up to Rs.50,000. Kishore covers loans above Rs.50,000 up to Rs.5 lakh. Tarun covers loans above Rs.5 lakh up to Rs.10 lakh. Tarun Plus offers loans up to Rs.20 lakh for entrepreneurs who have repaid Tarun loans.
who_can_apply: Individuals, proprietary concerns, partnership firms, private limited companies, public companies and other legal forms may apply. Applicants must not be defaulters and should have a satisfactory credit track record. Required skills or experience depend on the proposed activity.
documents: Identity proof such as voter ID, PAN or Aadhaar; address proof like recent electricity or telephone bill; recent colour photograph; proof of identity or address of the business enterprise; and, for larger loans, last two years’ balance sheets.
how_to_apply: Visit the PM Mudra website and open the Udyamimitra portal. Click “Apply Now”, choose entrepreneur type and register with name, email and mobile to get an OTP. Fill personal and business details, select loan category, attach documents and submit. An application number is generated.
